TABLE.NAME: local_msgrules_rule
TABLE.COMMENT: One row per ALLOWED cohort-to-cohort direction. Absence of a row means that direction is denied.

FIELD.NAME: fromcohortid
FIELD.COMMENT: Sender cohort. 0 is the pseudo-cohort for users who belong to no cohort at all.

FIELD.NAME: tocohortid
FIELD.COMMENT: Recipient cohort. 0 is the pseudo-cohort for users who belong to no cohort at all.

TABLE.NAME: local_msgrules_managed
TABLE.COMMENT: The message_users_blocked rows this plugin owns, so a rebuild never touches a block a user made themselves.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The recipient - owner of the block row, matching message_users_blocked.userid.

FIELD.NAME: blockeduserid
FIELD.COMMENT: The sender kept out, matching message_users_blocked.blockeduserid.
